title: spec/docs: agent.zod.ts still says the absorbed agent-knowledge-topics-to-sources conversion remains in the chain; agents.mdx can name the excess-property tsc error
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxBECSPtHxQMZDHSie

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37967. The source is the contract record 7222359751 on PR #38003 (nits N1 and N2) and L1-a's ACCEPT 7222372893 on the same head, which asks for one small card taking both. The owning area files it under the source card.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 · reach: readers of the `agent.zod.ts` docblock and of the shipped `ai/agents` docs page · evidence: read on `main`.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：规格源码里一句注释说某个协议 17 的转换「仍在链上」，其实它在发布前就被合并掉了，现在没有任何地方注册它；另外对外文档 ai/agents 页可以补半句：直接在 `defineAgent` 里写这两个已退役字段，TypeScript 编译仍会报「多余属性」错误。
- 谁受益：读规格源码和文档的作者，看到的说法与实际一致。
- 不做会怎样：只是一句注释和一处可补充的说明，不影响任何行为。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. **N1, spec comment.** `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` ~:102-103 (after PR #38003; ~:104-105 on its head): "The protocol-17 `agent-knowledge-topics-to-sources` conversion remains in the chain (it rewrites historical SOURCES and imports nothing from here)." No registry or entry module carries that id; `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/17/sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit.ts:17` records it as "ABSORBED — `agent-knowledge-topics-to-sources` (protocol 17, #3855)", and `retired-after.census.json` has no row for it. Correct the sentence to what the tree says. Comment only.
2. **N2, docs half-clause (optional per the record).** `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`, the `tools` and `knowledge` rows: `defineAgent` takes `z.input` of the strict `AgentSchema` (`agent.zod.ts` ~:645), a closed object type, so an inline `defineAgent({ …, tools: [...] })` literal still fails `tsc` as an excess property. Add that as a half-clause beside the parse refusal, without claiming the old by-name `never` refusal. If it does not read well in the table, leave it out and say so.

## Acceptance
- The `agent.zod.ts` sentence matches `sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit.ts:17` and the census; no schema, type or export changes.
- Any `agents.mdx` addition is true on `main` (a type-level check or a cited existing test).
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch (spec publishes `src/**/*.zod.ts`).

Blocked-by: #37967 (PR #38003)
Parent: #37967
Size: XS
Dedupe (objectstack, is:issue): `agent-knowledge-topics-to-sources` 14 (none open) · `"excess property" defineAgent` 0. No duplicate.
